items.title: Online sales are falling
items.headline: Online sales dropped for the second quarter in a row.
items.angle: Faster pages and a smoother checkout to win back conversions

items.title: Lost the No. 2 spot to a local rival
items.headline: A local sportswear retailer has moved ahead in online footwear sales.
items.angle: A mobile-first redesign that beats the rival on experience

items.title: Weak sales in South India
items.headline: Sales in the southern region lag behind the rest of the country.
items.angle: Regional languages and local landing pages

items.title: Shoppers moved to mobile
items.headline: Most visits now come from phones, often on slower networks.

summary: Nike is losing online share in India to a local rival, and the South is its weakest region. Lead the pitch with conversion (speed, mobile and checkout), then regional languages.
